description: CP1 admission contract for calculator-derived finance forecast claims.
purpose: This contract defines the finance forecast claim object that sits between inert calculator candidate cards and replay/CP2 truth scoring. It does not replace schema_cp1 or schema_cp2. It binds event windows, benchmark, horizon, and truth join keys so evaluator scorecards can refuse unbound candidates.

claim_status.constraint: Only admitted claims may be scored in cp1_admitted_only replay mode.

forecast_id.constraint: Stable claim id distinct from the calculator candidate id.

candidate_ref.constraint: Reference to the calculator candidate_forecast_card identity.forecast_id.

comparison_event_key.constraint: Variant-invariant event equivalence key used for paired generator comparisons. Must exclude forecast_id, candidate_ref, truth_join_key, generator_variant_id, calibrator_id, and forecast direction.

comparison_event_key_schema.constraint: Exactly finance_comparison_event_key_v0 for this contract version.

comparison_event_key_authority.constraint: Exactly tools/finance/event_keys.py. Admission, replay, resolution, and variant comparison must import this shared key primitive rather than reimplementing the hash recipe.

cp1_ref.constraint: Reference to the CP1 admission policy or CP1 commitment surface.

as_of.constraint: ISO 8601 subject-time timestamp. This is the T-n evidence boundary.

lane.constraint: Calculator lane/universe such as stock, macro, or etf.

members.constraint: Uppercase member ids whose truth rows must be joined under the event contract.

event_start.constraint: ISO 8601 event start. Must equal subject.as_of for v1.

event_end.constraint: ISO 8601 event end. Must be after event_start.

direction.constraint: Directional hit target for the event.

aggregation.constraint: How member returns are aggregated; v1 default is equal_weight_member_return.

outcome_basis.constraint: Defines the claim-level binary outcome used by proper scoring. equal_weight_group_return_direction scores the aggregate group return vs benchmark; mean_member_binary_hit preserves legacy per-member mean-Brier behavior explicitly.

member_diagnostics_basis.constraint: Names the diagnostic-only member outcome construction. v1.1 default is per_member_directional_hit.

benchmark_member_policy.constraint: Controls benchmark-as-target ambiguity for benchmark-relative group events. Production default is reject_if_benchmark_is_member; compatibility fixtures may explicitly include the benchmark as zero excess or exclude it from the claim-level outcome while retaining diagnostics.

directional_hit_probability.constraint: Closed interval [0, 1]. Means probability that the stated UP/DOWN direction is correct, not probability of UP.

source_kind.constraint: Must preserve whether probability is a calculator score proxy or calibrated posterior.

comparison_event_key.constraint: Copied top-level comparison_event_key so deterministic truth rows and replay scorecards can carry event equivalence separately from truth lineage.

truth_source.constraint: Expected truth artifact family, usually prediction_reconciliation.

required_truth_fields.constraint: Must include target_id, truth_join_key, comparison_event_key, event_start, event_end, horizon, benchmark, event_type, outcome_basis, benchmark_member_policy, member_return, and benchmark_return.

candidate_only_not_cp1_commitment.constraint: Must be false on admitted claims.

cp1_commitment.constraint: Must be true on admitted claims.

leakage_guard.constraint: Must name subject-time-only inputs plus horizon embargo.

replay_contract.rule: tools/finance/eval_replay.py default mode may score only finance_forecast_claim_v1 claims with bound event and truth_binding fields.
replay_contract.outcome_basis_rule: The Brier event_outcome must be derived from event.outcome_basis. Member hit rates are diagnostics unless outcome_basis is explicitly mean_member_binary_hit.
replay_contract.variant_pairing_rule: Variant comparisons must pair scorecards by comparison_event_key, not by forecast_id, candidate_ref, truth_join_key, generator_variant_id, or forecast direction. Identity fields remain audit metadata only.
replay_contract.comparison_event_key_authority_rule: tools/finance/event_keys.py is the single implementation authority for finance_comparison_event_key_v0 normalization and hashing. Other finance evaluator modules may copy or validate the key but must not redefine its digest recipe.
